positiveObservations: Worker reads as a clothed adult human, not a geometric placeholder; visible head/torso/arms/legs, distinct hands and bare feet.
Brown cloth and darker trousers separate from skin; S versus rear N visibly differ; SE has independently different face and limb occlusion.
House broad roof/wall volumes give a coherent isometric silhouette; tree trunk/canopy silhouette is immediately legible.

defects.observation: S/N mostly read as upright frontal/back elevation with limited top-plane visibility or vertical foreshortening. SE face is near profile while torso is less turned. The set does not yet establish a consistently elevated RTS camera.
defects.next: Root/human select intended camera and judge a common visible top/head/shoulder/foot plane before animation.

defects.observation: Straight hanging arms and nearly parallel narrow legs create a stiff standing silhouette. Shoulder/elbow/hip/knee landmarks remain compressed into angular cloth contours at128; the drawing is human-readable but this does not certify realistic anatomy.
defects.next: Refine weight-bearing stance and readable limb joints in a still without treating a palette/proportion match as anatomy approval.

defects.observation: Bright sash/crossover and abrupt light/dark strips along trouser legs compete with body volume. N upper back has a broad light shoulder patch which reads as a separate panel more than soft cloth volume.
defects.next: Review material shading clusters and garment construction; keep sash/cut explicitly proposed.

defects.observation: Roof texture consists of repeated diagonal rectangular strokes, giving a shingle/tile-like surface more strongly than layered fibrous thatch.
defects.next: If the asset is labelled thatch, author irregular bundled/layered fibre clusters rather than repeated roof units.

defects.observation: Broad framed grid opening, highly regular wall panels and crisp plinth are visually clear but not established by the current17c poor-village evidence. Dampier describes small square openings and low mud/daubed-wattle walls.
defects.next: Keep construction proposed; consider smaller simple opening/daubed wall cues for the specific northern poor-worker setting.

defects.observation: Large flat angular canopy lobes with many small bright leaf flecks read somewhat patterned; trunk ends below an opaque flat canopy without visible branching transition.
defects.next: Optional volume/branch refinement after human approves overall pixel style; species stays unknown.

defects.observation: Brown/dark figures have modest luminance separation from the muted green ground; thin outlines and internal details weaken in the wide scene.
defects.next: Human judge gameplay readability with actual selection/health UI and intended density before committing animation.

runtimeScreenshots.limitation: Screenshots show private still scene; no interaction, game-controller behavior, animation or ordinary-game runtime independently exercised.
observations: Both scene sizes show legible house/tree/riverbank and three distinct workers; UI identifies a static art study.
At scene scale workers remain human-readable, but dark brown figures have modest contrast on muted green ground and the nearly frontal camera remains conspicuous beside isometric house.
1366 layout partly obscures/crops left trees behind fixed UI; central house and all three workers remain visible.1920 gives clearer composition.
Study overlay explicitly labels three standing poses rather than animation and proposed tunic/headcloth; enlarged and native silhouettes are visible.

historicalReview: Dampier brown/tawny cotton cue used plausibly; exact garment cut/headcloth/house construction remain PROPOSED. No claim of period authenticity.
nextDependency: Human/root decide visual direction and supply exact ordinary-engine scene screenshots. Any revisions require new hashes and a bounded follow-up review.
